description: A ground-level photograph depicts a quiet residential street scene. On the right, a row of at least three detached or semi-detached houses with light-coloured vertical siding and red-orange tiled roofs are visible. Each house is set behind a small, neatly trimmed green lawn and a dense green hedge. In the immediate foreground, a paved brick pathway transitions to a darker, possibly asphalt, road on the left. Two utility structures are positioned near the hedges: a light-grey rectangular box mounted on a pole, and a wooden slatted bin with a green top. Scattered trees are present in the background and along the street. The houses exhibit a consistent architectural style, characteristic of a developed, potentially suburban or "Dense Urban fabric" residential area.
